_note: Hand-curated contest-level facts. Primary source: the Board 8 wiki contest overview infoboxes (dumped by local/board8wiki-infobox-dump.py). Entrant names are normalized to the canonical forms in data/board8wiki/match-records.json. Each notable match carries poll, m (a readable label) and url (the Board 8 wiki writeup, from match-records). notable_raw is the infobox's own wording, kept for provenance; notable_notes explains any deviation (e.g. an infobox 'All X Matches' category expanded to specific polls). Best Year in Gaming (tid 17) has no wiki infobox; its fields come from storage/GameFAQs Pages/byg_stats.html + match-records. Dates are the infobox's stated values (ISO); where match-records disagree by more than a day or refer to a different phase, see date_notes. When notable_matches or winner is null, downstream should fall back to the ChatGPT list / computed champion.
